craft_notes: Sthāyin: seat-joy. sthaṇḍile'thavā (ṇ) kept. Close: making. Rejected: 'idol' — killed.

lines: Flowers foremost, all in order — emblem or altar;
with fourteen mutterings, the flower-seat prepare.
l4.sanskrit_cite: puṣpādikaṃ kramāt sarvaṃ liṅge vā sthaṇḍile'thavā caturdaśābhijaptena puṣpeṇāsanakalpanā |

reads_against.argmap: Flowers, mark or altar; by fourteen muttered, flower seat-making.
c1_essence: Flowers, mark or altar; fourteen-muttered seat.
